'''Gennan Var''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].

==Biography==
Gennan Var was a member of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] for [[Ganis]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal, in the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="CSWECite">{{CSWECite|I|320|Ganis the Hutt}}</ref> fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Ganis was the target of an assassination by his rival, fellow Hutt [[Nawnam]]. It was a complete failure, however, and a 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on Nawnam. Var, and his mercenary team [[Stalkers]], began to hunt for him.<ref name="HeavyLifting" />

He confronted [[F'ej D'aw]] in the [[Vapor Scream]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in an attempt to claim the bounty on [[Nawnam]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. After D'aw escaped and return to the warehouse where Nawnam was hiding, the bounty hunter found them again and attacked.<ref name="HeavyLifting" />

==Personality and traits==
Var was light-skinned, missing one of his<ref name="HeavyLifting" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]<ref name="GuideAlienSpecies">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> head-tails, and had several vicious-looking scars. When he tried to capture D'aw at the Vapor Scream, he ordered the Stalkers to take the Klatooinian alive, but anyone who got in their way could be killed as needed.<ref name="HeavyLifting" />

==Skills and abilities==
In combat, Var was skilled with a blaster and dodged well. He could operate [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]], [[Realspace/Legends|space]] transports and their gunnery. He also good at [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], starship repair, and security. Var's skills in discernment included bargaining, searching, and sneaking around. Knowledge of his centered around value and the street knowledge of Hutt crime syndicates.<ref name="HeavyLifting" />

==Equipment==
He wore a stun cloak and [[Cresh Luck armor/Legends|cresh luck armor]] with an infrared motion sensor array. The array, once it detected an object of ten kilograms or more moving at one meter per second, would trigger an internal alarm. Var armed himself with a [[GLX Firelance]] blaster rifle and [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]. Other items of his included a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] and a comlink.<ref name="HeavyLifting" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gennan Var first appeared in "[[Heavy Lifting]]," an adventure for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' included in the [[1997]] book ''[[Instant Adventures]]''. Var was illustrated by the artists [[Paul Daly]] and [[Chris Trevas]].<ref name="HeavyLifting" />
